notes.recognition: Open olive mineral ground reads as the most traversable terrain at thumbnail size.
notes.agency: The calm value field lets movement and route choices remain the active information.
notes.specificity: Mineral lichen helps continuity, though this is intentionally the least exotic biome.
notes.restraint: Low contrast and broad patches protect silhouettes and interaction rings.
notes.continuity: Olive, charcoal, and rare warm flecks preserve the established signal hierarchy.
notes.reusability: The surface tolerates crops, rotation, tint, and repeated tile use.
notes.accessibility: Large value-separated patches survive desaturation and small rendering.
